Host lifecycle, hello, and macOS/Windows no-flag app sessions are implemented; Linux no-flag product boot is absent.
WKWebView, WebView2, and WebKitGTK backends exist; persistent profile identity, the destination engine policy, and the renderer bridge remain incomplete.
kipc framing, codecs, HELLO authentication, Unix bootstrap, and the Windows named-pipe app-link are implemented; channel registry and shared-memory lanes are absent.
Manifest parsing, evaluation, verified startup loading, and guard-before-handler dispatch exist; generated grants and audit logging remain target behavior.
The scoped filesystem broker is guard-checked and live; the other planned native services are absent.
Single-child supervision, crash accounting, macOS guardians, Windows primary generations, and the standalone Linux strict mechanism exist; full named-role and product strict admission remain absent.
Only the update channel contract exists; signed manifests, delta application, rollback, and feeds are not implemented.
Only the packaging format contract exists; installers, signing, notarization, and cross-target assembly are not implemented.
Compatibility evidence types, scoring, and lifecycle conformance exist; broad Electron host emulation is absent.
The shipping host owns hello and macOS/Windows no-flag sessions; Linux no-flag integration and the destination registry are absent.
create, dev, doctor, MCP, hello, and IPC diagnostics exist; build, migrate, gen, and ext remain reserved.
The Electron facade implements lifecycle and the app-link client; the wider Electron module surface is absent.
The typed SDK for supervised Bun roles is specified but no package is tracked.
The renderer bridge and polyfill package are specified but no package is tracked.
The npm binary resolver is specified but no package is tracked.
The contract-definition and code-generation package is specified but no package is tracked.
The package-manager scaffolding entrypoint is specified but no package is tracked.
The tracked workspace, architecture, agent workflow, and CI exist; the first attributed performance harness remains absent.
macOS and Windows no-flag app sessions exist; Linux product boot and the full public role API remain absent.
MCP v1, permission evaluation, guard dispatch, and one filesystem broker exist; bulk IPC, codegen, and broad compatibility remain absent.
The standalone Linux strict mechanism is implemented and proven; product admission, distribution, signed updates, remaining OS profiles, limits, reporting, and addon workers remain incomplete.
Compatibility-depth, corpus, pinned-engine, and stable-plugin goals are specified but not implemented.

The shipping app-link uses a current-user protected named pipe plus HELLO; distinct ordinary-user denial and authorized same-user successor echo are proven, while decimal diagnostic compatibility remains.
The no-flag host, native window, app link, recovery, and ordered cleanup are implemented for the current slice.
